lines.cap: If you're alone, and it gets stuck deep in your throat, bend over the back of a chair.
lines.say: If you're alone, and it gets stuck deep in your throat, bend over the back of a chair.

lines.cap: Choking. You can't talk, can't breathe, can't cough. Hands go to the throat.
lines.say: Choking. You can't talk, can't breathe, can't cough. Hands go to the throat.

lines.cap: First, call emergency services if you can. Even if you can't speak, they can trace the call.
lines.say: First, call emergency services if you can. Even if you can't speak, they can trace the call.

lines.cap: If you can still cough, keep coughing hard. That's the best way out.
lines.say: If you can still cough, keep coughing hard. That's the best way out.

lines.cap: If not, make a fist, and put it just above your belly button. Grab it with your other hand, and push in and up, hard.
lines.say: If not, make a fist, and put it just above your belly button. Grab it with your other hand, and push in and up, hard.

lines.cap: Or lean over the back of a chair, and throw your weight onto it, again and again.
lines.say: Or lean over the back of a chair, and throw your weight onto it, again and again.

lines.cap: Keep going until it shoots out. Then get checked by a doctor.
